events.title: PostReady: PR #635 — Remove obsolete PostReady-IG Instagram interstitial
events.description: Removed the interstitial modal shown before the Instagram OAuth handoff — the "PostReady-IG" name explanation step is no longer needed, streamlining the Instagram connect flow.

events.title: PostReady: PR #636 — Redesign post-detail engagement + video cards (Post performance)
events.description: Redesigned the post-detail engagement section and video cards on the Post performance page, giving the analytics view a polished, consistent look aligned with the new design system.

events.title: PostReady: PR #637 — Hover-to-reveal engagement on posted pack cards
events.description: Added hover-to-reveal engagement stats on posted pack cards, surfacing likes, comments, and reach inline without navigating to the full post-detail page.

events.title: PostReady: PR #638 — Add GA4 analytics tag
events.description: Added Google Analytics 4 (GA4) analytics tag to the site, enabling product usage and funnel tracking across the PostReady web app.

events.title: PostReady: PR #639 — Add PostHog product analytics
events.description: Added PostHog product analytics to the PostReady web app, providing session recording, funnel analysis, and feature flag capabilities alongside the newly added GA4 integration.

events.title: PostReady: PR #641 — Fix mobile hero image ghosting/flicker on iOS Safari
events.description: Fixed a visual glitch where the hero image on the PostReady landing page would ghost or flicker on iOS Safari during scroll, improving mobile first impressions for prospective users.

events.title: PostReady: PR #642 — Fix violent mobile flicker in FeatureMarquee
events.description: Fixed a severe mobile flicker caused by a competing masked scroller and momentum scroll interaction in the FeatureMarquee component, improving landing page smoothness on iOS and Android.

events.title: PostReady: PR #644 — Fix: pin prompt-box height on mobile — root cause of landing-page flicker
events.description: Pinned the prompt-box height on mobile to eliminate the root cause of the persistent landing-page flicker, fully resolving the iOS/Android scroll jank that prior fixes had partially addressed.

events.title: PostReady: PR #647 — Multi-scene video (Seedance 2.0) + branded end card + 3-color palette
events.description: Rebuilt multi-scene video on Seedance 2.0 for continuity (one reference-to-video job instead of fragile fan-out). Added a deterministic brand layer: business name kept out of Seedance prompts, branded end card with logo and name, and a 3-color palette system for on-screen text overlays.

events.title: PostReady: PR #648 — Settings polish: masonry cards, icon headers, combined Refer & Redeem, end-card preview fix
events.description: Polished the Settings page with masonry card layout, icon-style section headers, a combined Refer & Redeem panel, and a fix for the end-card preview — improving visual consistency and usability across account management.
